channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Victor Oladipo | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Victor Oladipo from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Sam Presti on Victor Oladipo
item.description:
Sam Presti says Victor Oladipo won’t be at camp:

“VO is great. He’s been through a lot. He’ll be back this season at some point. But with our roster situation, we can’t prioritize that. But we’re big fans of Victor.”

Sam Presti on Victor Oladipo, Sep 27, 2023. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Bam Adebayo on Victor Oladipo
item.description:
Barry Jackson:Bam Adebayo, on Victor Oladipo:

“We haven't heard from Vic yet. I think he's good because he walked off on his own.”

Bam Adebayo on Victor Oladipo, Apr 22, 2023. Source: Twitter @flasportsbuzz.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Victor Oladipo
item.description:
Brady Hawk:Erik Spoelstra on Victor Oladipo:

“I feel like throwing up right now, but I don’t know what the diagnosis is. I want to stay positive on this.”

Erik Spoelstra on Victor Oladipo, Apr 22, 2023. Source: Twitter @ByTimReynolds.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Victor Oladipo
item.description:
Erik Spoelstra, on Victor Oladipo injury:

“Vic, we don't know right now. We'll have him checked out tomorrow. I feel how everyone feels. Great win, but when you see a player go down like that - particularly a player like Vic, who has gone through so much. I don't know what it is right now.”

Erik Spoelstra on Victor Oladipo, Apr 22, 2023. Source: Twitter @flasportsbuzz.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Victor Oladipo
item.description:
Brady Hawk:Erik Spoelstra on Victor Oladipo:

“He’s a major X-factor for our team. That’s what we had hoped for. That’s what we anticipated.”

Erik Spoelstra on Victor Oladipo, Jan 14, 2023. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Pat Riley on Victor Oladipo
item.description:
Pat Riley on Oladipo:

“Victor showed his work ethic and determination to come back and help us win games at the end of the regular season and through the playoffs. We are delighted to have him back in a Heat uniform.”

Pat Riley on Victor Oladipo, Jul 7, 2022. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Bam Adebayo on Victor Oladipo
item.description:
Heat center Bam Adebayo said of Oladipo in advance of Monday’s game.

“And in my opinion, once he gets his groove back, he could be that version of Oladipo he was when he was in Indiana. I feel like people forget Oladipo because he’s been hurt that long. So we get that version of Victor back, him being in this culture with his hard-working work ethic and getting your body to be the best of his ability, I feel like you’re adding that to like a high-caliber team.”

Bam Adebayo on Victor Oladipo, Mar 7, 2022. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Pat Riley on Victor Oladipo
item.description:
“We really like Victor’s versatility and how he impacts the game in multiple ways,”

Pat Riley on Victor Oladipo, Aug 7, 2021. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Pat Riley on Victor Oladipo
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Pat Riley on Victor Oladipo:

“We'll see what happens in August when we sit down and talk with him.”

Pat Riley on Victor Oladipo, Jun 3, 2021. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Rafael Stone on Victor Oladipo
item.description:
Salman Ali:Rafael Stone:

“We made a decision organizationally Victor [Oladipo] fit wasn't a good one. At that point, what do you do? So then it became make a deal that has some upside.”

Rafael Stone on Victor Oladipo, Mar 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Stephen Silas on Victor Oladipo
item.description:
Salman Ali:Stephen Silas on holding out Victor Oladipo:

“The long-term health of Vic is most importantand that's how we're approaching it with all of our guys.”

Stephen Silas on Victor Oladipo, Jan 23, 2021. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Rafael Stone on Victor Oladipo
item.description:
Rockets GM Rafael Stone on Victor Oladipo:

“Your hope is it’s a perfect marriage. He’s an extremely talented player. ...For him and for us, this is a really exciting time where we get to see how it works out. Hopefully, it works out gangbusters and we go from there.”

Rafael Stone on Victor Oladipo, Jan 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Rafael Stone on Victor Oladipo
item.description:
Stone on Oladipo:

“Your hope is that it's a perfect marriage. He's an extremely talented player, a two-way player. In his own mind and ours, there's still room to grow.”

Rafael Stone on Victor Oladipo, Jan 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @clutchfans.

item.title: Stephen Silas on Victor Oladipo
item.description:
David Hardisty:Silas on Victor Oladipo:

“To have Vic, it's exciting. He fits into a lot of things I believe: A go-to guy, a downhill player... He's also a quality, quality defensive player. He's a true two-way guy.”

Stephen Silas on Victor Oladipo, Jan 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @clutchfans.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Victor Oladipo
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:Pritchard on Oladipo:

“We have a great relationship. He feels good about the team. ... We hear a lot of things. Until it comes to me, I don't really worry about that.... That's a ways down the line.”

Kevin Pritchard on Victor Oladipo, Oct 21, 2020. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Tim Bontemps on Victor Oladipo
item.description:
“I think it’s unlikely Oladipo gets traded because of how weird his past year has been,”

Tim Bontemps on Victor Oladipo, Oct 21, 2020. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Victor Oladipo
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:Pritchard on Oladipo:

“My goal is to have a direct relationship with Victor. Sometimes you have to just sit in front of someone, have a conversation, ask the tough questions, be open and honest. I have not heard anything other than he wants to be here.”

Kevin Pritchard on Victor Oladipo, Aug 31, 2020. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Victor Oladipo
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:McMillan on playing in traffic (Oladipo 6 TOs):

“Until we penetrated and kick and attack their closeouts, they're going to make you pay”

Nate McMillan on Victor Oladipo, Aug 20, 2020. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Victor Oladipo
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:McMillan on Oladipo's left eye:

“It wasn't an option (for him to return). His vision was really blurry. He really couldn't see out of his eye when we saw him at halftime”

Nate McMillan on Victor Oladipo, Aug 18, 2020. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Victor Oladipo, TJ Warren, Malcolm Brogdon
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:McMillan:

“I'll be talking with all of our guys, what I saw. I just won't only be talking to Victor. I'll be talking with Malcolm and Warren and Myles on where they think we are.”

Nate McMillan on Victor Oladipo, TJ Warren, Malcolm Brogdon, Jul 28, 2020. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Victor Oladipo
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:McMillan on Oladipo:

“I just spoke on him when I left the locker room. He said he felt good.”

Nate McMillan on Victor Oladipo, Jul 26, 2020. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Victor Oladipo
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:McMillan on if he expects Oladipo to play in any of the 3 scrimmages:

“I do. He's going through the practices. He's looking good. We'll see how our guys feel.”

Nate McMillan on Victor Oladipo, Jul 20, 2020. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Doug McDermott on Victor Oladipo, TJ Warren
item.description:
Scott Agness:Doug McDermott:

“Really impressed with T.J. Warren. Victor (Oladipo), in particular, looks phenomenal. I’m really excited to see him back on the floor.”

Doug McDermott on Victor Oladipo, TJ Warren, Jul 17, 2020. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Victor Oladipo
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:McMillan on Oladipo and possible restrictions:

“There are no restrictions on him in practice and that's pretty much were we are right now.”

Nate McMillan on Victor Oladipo, Jul 15, 2020. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Victor Oladipo
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:McMillan on Oladipo's decision:

“His call. I guess he didn't feel he would be ready to go. He has always planned to go to Orlando and play 5 on 5. He still plans ... to be involved with all the practices. There are no restrictions.”

Nate McMillan on Victor Oladipo, Jul 8, 2020. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Victor Oladipo
item.description:
Ian Begley:Pacers president of basketball operations Kevin Pritchard on Victor Oladipo:

“We totally respect and understand Victor’s decision to not play in the restart of the NBA’s season.”

Kevin Pritchard on Victor Oladipo, Jul 3, 2020. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Reggie Miller on Victor Oladipo
item.description:
“I don't see a lot of load management for Oladipo. I think they want to make a push to get to that fourth spot.”

Reggie Miller on Victor Oladipo, Feb 28, 2020. Source: Indianapolis Star.

item.title: Jim Boylen on Victor Oladipo
item.description:
Jim Boylen on Victor Oladipo return:

“I'm very happy for him. He's a terrific guy. That injury was a really tough one. I'm sure he has worked as hard as anybody from what I know of him. He's a competitive guy. It's good for the league that he's back.”

Jim Boylen on Victor Oladipo, Jan 28, 2020. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Victor Oladipo, Domantas Sabonis
item.description:
“Here’s what happened: When Victor was in [OKC’s offer] and they said, ‘Okay fine, we’ll put Sabonis in too,’ in my mind, the deal was done,”

Kevin Pritchard on Victor Oladipo, Domantas Sabonis, Jan 25, 2020. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Victor Oladipo, Domantas Sabonis
item.description:
“When I heard Domantas’ name along with Victor’s name, I felt like that was enough. You can be really, really greedy in this business. But I felt like Sam [Presti] made a really honest, good offer and it was what I wanted to hear. I felt good about it.”

Kevin Pritchard on Victor Oladipo, Domantas Sabonis, Jan 25, 2020. Source: HoopsHype.
